# Security Privacy And Access

Use this instruction when defining or implementing security and privacy controls.

## Core Focus

- Differentiate clearly between coach, end-user, and admin roles.
- Protect tools, content, and configuration through authentication and authorization.
- Apply rate limiting per user and per tool where relevant.
- Record audit logs for important access and change events.
- Define data retention, archival, and deletion rules.
- Produce terms and conditions plus a privacy policy draft.
- Support GDPR-style account and data deletion capabilities.

| Task | Status | Notes |

| Draft terms and conditions plus privacy policy. | not_started | No legal draft files exist yet. |
| Implement GDPR-style deletion options. | not_started | No account or data deletion flow exists yet. |

## Output Expectations

- Treat privacy and access design as product requirements, not just legal cleanup.
- Prefer explicit permission rules over implicit assumptions.
- Ensure deletion and retention policies can be executed operationally, not just described.
